subject: Leadership checkpoint — OKR triage and dependency playbook
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, qbr-coordinator@acme.com
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Leadership checkpoint — OKR triage and dependency playbook

Team —

Attached a compact packet for the mid-quarter leadership checkpoint (QBR prep). This is intentionally short — the goal today is to agree on a small set of scope moves and committed owners we can carry into the QBR deck. Key asks are listed at the top. Please review and reply with one-line confirmations or suggested owners.

Snapshot (high level):
- Product Velocity OKR (PV-1): On track for feature parity; integration test flakiness is blocking rollouts in 2 regions.
- Latency & Cost OKR (LC-2): Significant work underway on batching/kv-cache; we will miss the 15% cost target if we do all micro-optimizations this quarter.
- Reliability OKR (R-3): Error budget burn is within tolerance, but two infra tickets (I-811, I-822) are blocking rollout to Dedicated customers.

Proposed triage (short):
1) Re-scope LC-2 for Q4: move micro-quantization effort to backlog, focus on caching/batching path to capture most wins now. Owner: Vanessa. Decision needed by Thu EOD.
2) Allocate 0.5 FTE infra support (on-call + 1 sprint) to clear I-811/I-822 so Dedicated rollout isn’t delayed. Owner: Markus to confirm by Fri.
3) Push non-blocking integration tests to a targeted smaller cohort (10% of customers) while we stabilize test infra. Owner: Aditya to lead test re-targeting, decision by Wed.

Action items (summary):
- Vanessa: confirm re-scope acceptance and recommended trade (reduce micro-quant efforts) — due Thu EOD.
- Markus: confirm infra allocation and which engineer(s) — due Fri noon.
- Aditya: provide quick plan to retarget integration tests + estimated rollout timeline — due Wed 5pm.
- Laura: I need a one-slide leadership tradeoff summary for the QBR — can you take this? Due Fri EOD.

Attachments: QBR-pack-v1.pdf (deck), okr-triage-matrix.xlsx (matrix with suggested cut lines).

Why this matters: the QBR will be concrete — we need a reproducible list of what we are committing to (and what we are deferring). I’m trying to avoid last-minute scope swaps in the deck.

Please reply inline with owners or brief confirmations.

Thanks,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership checkpoint — OKR triage and dependency playbook

Kimberly —

Thanks for the concise packet. I support the targeted re-scope for LC-2. Micro-quant work is high ROI long-term but low ROI for this quarter given test infra risk. If we pivot to caching/batching now we should capture ~60% of the savings you modeled.

Two asks from my side:
- We need an infra sandbox for validating batching changes end-to-end; that is different from the infra hotfixes Markus calls out. If infra can give us a sandbox by Thu, we can lock down the cut.
- Recommend we keep a short list of fallback metrics for the QBR (latency p95, cost/unit, rollout risk). I’ll draft the slide with those metrics if Laura can incorporate the trade notes.

Owner confirmations: I’ll take LC-2 re-scope and will send a short note with the precise reduced scope by Thu noon.

Vanessa
VP, Product
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Leadership checkpoint — OKR triage and dependency playbook

Thanks everyone — quick consolidated plan below (finalized for QBR slide).

Decisions made:
- LC-2 re-scoped: focus on caching + batching; micro-quant deferred to Q4 backlog. Owner: Vanessa (deliverable: one-slide reduced-scope and metric targets) — due Thu EOD.
- Infra hotfix allocation approved: Samir & Priya to address I-811 and I-822 starting Wed; Markus to confirm weekly check-ins.
- Integration test cohort narrowed: Aditya to run a 10% targeted rollout and report rollback criteria by Wed 5pm.
- Leadership slide: Laura will produce a single tradeoff slide showing what we keep, what we cut, and what we defer.

Open items and notes:
- Sandbox for staging caching validations: Markus to create by Thu morning; if not available we will run validations in controlled windows with infra on-call.
- QBR deck will call out deferred items explicitly so customers and partners see the trade (avoid surprise).

Actions assigned (with deadlines):
- Vanessa: reduced-scope slide + metric targets — Thu EOD.
- Markus: infra allocation confirmation + sandbox status — Thu 11am.
- Aditya: integration test plan and rollback criteria — Wed 5pm.
- Laura: leadership tradeoff slide — Fri EOD.
- Kimberly: consolidate and send final QBR pack to qbr-coordinator@acme.com — Fri 6pm.

I’ll update the shared matrix and the HubSpot thread after each deliverable lands. Thanks for quick responses — this gives us a clean, defensible narrative for the QBR.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
